story.titleZh: 巴库大奖赛发车：拉塞尔领跑，皮亚斯特里升至第二
story.summaryZh: F1官方在X上发布阿塞拜疆大奖赛巴库站正式发车的消息：拉塞尔起步顺利领跑进入一号弯，皮亚斯特里升至第二，领先勒克莱尔。

LIGHTS OUT IN BAKU!!!
It's a smooth start from Russell who leads into Turn 1 and Piastri gets up to P2 ahead of Leclerc! 
#F1 #AzerbaijanGP
detailZh:
⚫️⚫️⚫️⚫️⚫️
巴库五盏红灯熄灭，比赛正式开始！
拉塞尔起步顺畅，领跑进入一号弯，皮亚斯特里升至第二位，领先勒克莱尔！

⚫️⚫️⚫️⚫️⚫️

#F1 #AzerbaijanGP
keyPointsZh: 皮亚斯特里发车后升至第二位，领先勒克莱尔
比赛地点为巴库，属阿塞拜疆大奖赛
keyPointsEn: Piastri moved up to second place ahead of Leclerc at the start
The race is the Azerbaijan Grand Prix in Baku

media.altZh: 哈贾尔时隔三站重返赛场，斩获生涯第三个领奖台

relatedItems.originalTitle: We see you, Isack! 😍 After three races on the sidelines, the Frenchman came back and claimed the third podium of his career 💪 #F1 #AzerbaijanGP ...
relatedItems.summaryEn:
We see you, Isack! 😍
After three races on the sidelines, the Frenchman came back and claimed the third podium of his career 💪
#F1 #AzerbaijanGP @redbullracing
detailZh: 我们看见你了，伊萨克！😍 在连续三站比赛缺席之后，这位法国车手回归并夺得了职业生涯的第三个领奖台 💪 #F1 #阿塞拜疆大奖赛 @redbullracing
detailEn:
We see you, Isack! 😍
After three races on the sidelines, the Frenchman came back and claimed the third podium of his career 💪
#F1 #AzerbaijanGP @redbullracing
keyPointsZh: 这是哈贾尔职业生涯的第三个领奖台。
此前他曾连续三站比赛没有参赛。
本站比赛为阿塞拜疆大奖赛。
keyPointsEn: He had previously missed three races while on the sidelines.
